decision.observation: Goose stands right beside the gate's right post; the U-shaped latch handle is at ~(0.605, 0.49), at head height; the lower elbow pipe is at ~(0.62, 0.63). Pointer is exactly on the U-handle.
decision.hypothesis: A plain grabbed left-press on the U-handle (no Ctrl) will let the goose grip the latch; then dragging/moving the pointer left will pull it and swing the gate open. Right-click is only zoom-out, so a left grab is correct.
decision.memory: Controls: grab = left mouse or Z; Ctrl+left is bend-pickup; right-click = zoom out.
